newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.78 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.78 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 8.0 trillion lire 28-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 6.78 percent, compared with 7.29 percent at the previous repo tender on May 13, the Bank said.

This was the lowest rate since the central bank introduced lira repurchase auctions in 1982. Minimum rates were above seven percent until the start of this month and the previous lowest minimum rate was 6.99 percent at a repo 14 days ago.
Today's average rate was 6.83 percent against 7.34 percent at the May 13 pact which was for 5.5 trillion lire and two days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on June 16. The Bank said it received 35 bids of which 24 were met in full and four in part.
